title: Per-turn budget, deadline, cost, cancellation and late responses
scope: packages/agent-runtime only: per-turn counters reset per runTurn; budgeted stages model.generate/tool.execute/outbox.enqueue denied before start (steps_budget_exceeded, model_calls_exhausted, tool_calls_exhausted, loop_cost_exceeded); deadlineAt check before each stage and after each await; cooperative cancellation via GovernedTurnInput.cancelSignal propagated to modelGateway.generate(signal) and ToolInvocation.signal with turn_cancelled; late results discarded; all spans closed on success/error/timeout/cancel. Journal/proposal semantics from AAA-09/10 preserved.
unchangedByThisLane: packages/model-gateway/** (signal support already existed; no file touched)
docs/99_runtime_state.md, docs/20_master_execution_log.md, docs/30_backlog_master.md and shared tracking files

GovernedTurnInput.cancelSignal: optional AbortSignal; cooperative cancellation for the turn

ToolInvocation.signal: optional AbortSignal, same instance passed to the tool executor

GovernedTurnResult.effectConfirmed: optional boolean (honest effect state on denied outcomes)

behavior.counters: steps/modelCalls/toolCalls/costUsd are local to runTurn; limits apply only to the receiving turn and are not inherited
behavior.budgetedStages: policy.evaluate/approval/journal do not consume maxSteps; model.generate increments modelCalls, tool.execute increments toolCalls, outbox.enqueue only consumes a step
behavior.stepDenial: before starting any budgeted stage, steps >= maxSteps -> denied steps_budget_exceeded with no stage start
behavior.callDenial: modelCalls >= maxModelCalls -> model_calls_exhausted (0 = no call); toolCalls >= maxToolCalls -> tool_calls_exhausted (0 = no call)
behavior.deadline: deadlineAt = startedAt + maxDurationMs; checked before each stage and after each await; expiry -> loop_deadline_exceeded, no confirm/execute after deadline
behavior.cost: model cost accumulated; checked after the model and before tool/outbox -> loop_cost_exceeded with no effect
behavior.cancellation: cancelSignal checked before each stage and after each await -> turn_cancelled; late dependency result discarded (no tool/outbox); effect may have started -> journal/approval UNCERTAIN, never invented success
behavior.lateResponses: after deadline/cancel a late model/tool result cannot feed proposal, tool or outbox
behavior.lateModelAfterCancel: post-await stop check discards the result before proposal/tool/outbox; requestId/effects count zero
behavior.spanClosure: openSpans tracked; endSpan on normal paths; finish closes any remaining child as error before ending agent.turn; top-level safety net closes open children and root then rethrows on unexpected exceptions
behavior.outboxDeniedAfterEffect: denied with the limit reason plus effectConfirmed=true and outboxPending=true, never a denial suggesting absence of effect
behavior.journalBoundaries: stop after markEffectStarted/tool -> journal.markUncertain + approval.markUncertain; stop after confirmEffect -> denied with effectConfirmed true and outboxPending true (journal CONFIRMED preserved)
